panels.title: Active & Draining Cohorts Live Status Board

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    e.participant_id,
    e.experiment_id,
    e.generator_id,
    e.status,
    e.cycles_observed,
    e.max_cycles,
    ROUND(SUM(s.cash_dollars), 2) AS current_bankroll,
    ROUND(SUM(s.realized_pnl_dollars), 2) AS realized_pnl,
    SUM(s.trades) AS trade_count,
    e.started_at_ms,
    e.end_at_ms,
    e.drain_deadline_ms
FROM strategy_experiments e
LEFT JOIN strategy_standings s ON e.participant_id = s.participant_id AND e.experiment_id = s.experiment_id
WHERE e.status IN ('active', 'draining')
  AND ('$participant' = 'All' OR e.participant_id = '$participant')
GROUP BY e.participant_id, e.experiment_id
ORDER BY e.started_at_ms DESC;

panels.title: All-Time Top Experiments Hall of Fame (Ranked by Cohort ROI %)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    e.participant_id,
    e.experiment_id,
    e.generator_id,
    e.status,
    e.cycles_observed,
    ROUND(SUM(s.cash_dollars), 2) AS total_cash,
    ROUND(SUM(s.realized_pnl_dollars), 2) AS total_pnl,
    ROUND(AVG((s.cash_dollars - e.start_balance) / e.start_balance * 100.0), 2) AS cohort_roi_pct,
    SUM(s.trades) AS total_trades,
    SUM(s.wins) AS total_wins,
    SUM(s.losses) AS total_losses,
    ROUND(CASE WHEN SUM(s.trades) > 0 THEN (SUM(s.wins) * 100.0 / SUM(s.trades)) ELSE 0.0 END, 1) AS win_rate_pct,
    e.started_at_ms,
    e.completed_at_ms
FROM strategy_experiments e
JOIN strategy_standings s ON e.participant_id = s.participant_id AND e.experiment_id = s.experiment_id
WHERE ('$participant' = 'All' OR e.participant_id = '$participant')
  AND ('$experiment_status' = 'all' OR e.status = '$experiment_status')
GROUP BY e.participant_id, e.experiment_id
HAVING SUM(s.trades) >= CAST('$min_trades' AS INTEGER)
ORDER BY cohort_roi_pct DESC;

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    t.closed_at_ms AS time,
    (t.experiment_id || ' : ' || t.strategy_id) AS metric,
    (e.start_balance + SUM(t.pnl) OVER (PARTITION BY t.participant_id, t.experiment_id, t.strategy_id ORDER BY t.closed_at_ms ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) AS current_balance
FROM strategy_trades t
JOIN strategy_experiments e ON t.participant_id = e.participant_id AND t.experiment_id = e.experiment_id
WHERE t.closed_at_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND e.status IN ('active', 'draining')
  AND ('$participant' = 'All' OR t.participant_id = '$participant')
  AND ('$experiment' = 'All' OR t.experiment_id = '$experiment')
  AND ('$strategy' = 'All' OR t.strategy_id = '$strategy')
ORDER BY t.closed_at_ms ASC;

panels.title: Open Watching & Settling Positions in Active Cohorts

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    s.participant_id,
    s.experiment_id,
    s.strategy_id,
    s.watching_json,
    s.settling_json,
    s.updated_at_ms
FROM strategy_standings s
JOIN strategy_experiments e ON s.participant_id = e.participant_id AND s.experiment_id = e.experiment_id
WHERE e.status IN ('active', 'draining')
  AND (s.watching_json IS NOT NULL OR (s.settling_json IS NOT NULL AND s.settling_json != '[]'))
  AND ('$participant' = 'All' OR s.participant_id = '$participant')
  AND ('$experiment' = 'All' OR s.experiment_id = '$experiment')
ORDER BY s.updated_at_ms DESC;
